prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a true looping WALK CYCLE spritesheet for the approved Darklight Requiem character wearing Punhos da Ruína gauntlets and greaves. Exactly 8 distinct full-body animation drawings, two rows of four frames. All face perfectly LEFT (west), same orthographic profile camera, same head size, same baseline, in-place translation. Real transparent background, no ground, no labels. Use the supplied references for identity, costume and armor design. Keep youthful proportions, dark-red eyes #C40814 with clean skin [246,174,130], wavy brown hair, black clothes, small dark crimson aura around armor.

This is relaxed ordinary WALKING, NOT an attack, NOT running, NOT marching. Small natural 30 degree stride, low knees, feet clear ground by only a few pixels. Hips stay level. Arms hang loose with small opposed pendulum swing, not clenched ahead in combat guard. Avoid huge forward reach. Draw actual alternating legs and opposite occlusion.

8 phase order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
1 NEAR leg forward heel contact, FAR leg back toe support, NEAR arm back.
2 near foot flat carrying weight, far heel lifts and passes behind.
3 near leg under hip supporting, FAR leg bent slightly as foot passes beside ankle (low clearance).
4 NEAR leg moving back, FAR leg moving forward, near arm swinging forward.
5 FAR leg forward heel contact, NEAR leg back toe support, NEAR arm FORWARD. This is opposite contact to frame1: near thigh visibly slopes BACK to screen-right, far leg reaches FORWARD to screen-left from behind it. Do not redraw frame1.
6 far foot flat carrying weight, NEAR heel lifts.
7 FAR leg vertical under hip supporting, NEAR foot passing beside ankle with knee low.
8 FAR leg moving back, NEAR leg reaching forward ready for frame1, near arm swinging back.

Keep both feet low in all8. Frame5 must have different leg overlap and arm positions than frame1. Preserve connected complete characters; do not crop any anatomy or armor. Clear transparent gutters. Match original art sharpness with crisp clusters and outlines; no blur.
Costume: Sleeved long black coat, shoulder studs, silver belt chain. All eight frames this skin.
